_comment: Placement policy for llama-models.ini presets. Edited by an operator, read
by scripts/gpu_placement.py. Reserves are in bytes and are subtracted from
a card's total VRAM before any model is considered to fit on it.
'prefer' names ROCm indices that should carry work first. 'fallback' names
the ones that take what is left over. Indices are the runtime's own, as
reported by scripts/gpu_vram.py -- not sysfs card numbers.
The display reserve is applied on top of the per-device reserve, and only
to a device with a connected output. It is not a guess: 1551 MiB was the
measured idle residency of the desktop on card2 on 2026-09-05, recorded in
margin for a compositor or browser that grows after a model is resident.
_idle_baseline_comment: card0 and card2 measured 2026-09-05 on an idle set of cards immediately before a cold load: 26 MiB and 1551 MiB, recorded in docs/reference/GPU-EXECUTION-AND-MODEL-LOADING.md. card1 re-measured 2026-09-06 on a freshly booted host with the router up and every preset unloaded, where it holds 26 MiB and not the 385 MiB first recorded; it drives no display, so it has no desktop allocation to keep out of a residual, and 385 MiB was residue from an earlier load rather than an idle floor. Keyed by GPU UUID as scripts/gpu_vram.py reports it, not by ROCm index: a 2026-09-06 boot came up without the V620 and renumbered the remaining cards, which would have subtracted one card's baseline from another. A UUID with no card present is ignored, and a card whose UUID is absent here gets no baseline at all rather than a borrowed one. Only used by --verify, which subtracts these from measured residency: an inflated baseline is charged to the desktop rather than to the model and makes the estimate look more conservative than it is, so every figure here is the lowest reading seen for its card.
_min_slack_comment: Working headroom every placement rule plans against, on top of the per-device reserve. Without it the rules fill a card to its last modelled byte and produce knife-edge splits for a figure --verify measures as roughly 5 percent conservative.
_measured_comment: Residency somebody loaded and read, for the few presets where the KV upper bound decides the placement and is wrong in the safe direction. Only consulted by scripts/gpu_placement.py when 'context' still matches the preset's configured ctx-size, so editing ctx-size retires the measurement rather than carrying it onto a configuration nobody loaded. 'bytes' is net of the card's idle baseline, the same convention --verify uses. Adding an entry here is a claim that a model was loaded alone on the named device and the number was read from sysfs; it is not a place for estimates.

gemma4-heretic.method: loaded alone on ROCm0 at ctx 32768 with flash-attn on and q4_0 KV; card0 mem_info_vram_used 10632601600 less its 27836416 idle baseline; unloaded back to baseline
gemma4-heretic.note: Gemma 4's 1024-token sliding window is why the 14.88 GiB full-context bound overstates this by about 5 GiB. The measured figure fits ROCm0's 13.98 GiB of working headroom, so rule 1 applies and the preset serves 1,0,0.
